title: Duck Creek Developer
summary: Configures Duck Creek, a software suite that property and casualty (P&C) insurers use to run policies, billing and claims, so that products, rating and forms work as the business needs. Works in an insurance IT team or service company, alongside business analysts, testers and onshore client teams.
dailyDuties: Configure policy products and screens in Duck Creek Author
Change manuscripts for rating rules and premium calculations
Build and update policy forms and documents with XML and XSLT
Write SQL to check policy and premium data
Build integrations with rating and third-party services
Fix defects raised in QA and UAT
Join calls with onshore analysts on requirements

skills.expectation: Configure Duck Creek Policy, Billing or Claims for P&C insurance products
Build and change manuscripts for rating, underwriting rules and forms in Duck Creek Author
Write XML and XSLT for manuscripts, documents and data feeds
Understand the P&C policy lifecycle: quote, bind, endorse, renew and cancel
Query SQL Server to check policy, premium and billing data
Build and test integrations with rating, document and third-party services
Work with business analysts and onshore teams on requirements and defects
Write C# and .NET extensions around the Duck Creek platform
Add client-side logic to Duck Creek screens
Deploy and upgrade on Duck Creek OnDemand, the vendor's cloud
Unit test and support QA and UAT for each release
Move policies from legacy systems into Duck Creek
Work in sprints with onshore and offshore teams
